envelope.description: Call applyBuildDefaults from repo.add as a guarded follow-up

body.title: Call applyBuildDefaults from repo.add as a guarded follow-up
body.summary: In the repo.add handler of src/daemon/handler-runtime.ts, after the registration and the indexing start, call applyBuildDefaults(normalisedPath) with the handler's own configPath and writer, guarded like the steering and MCP follow-ups, and return its outcome as buildDefaults in the result. A failure is logged and never fails the add; no client input is needed. Its tests are in src/daemon/__tests__/handler-runtime.test.ts and, for the gate reading a stored default as an ordinary setting, src/daemon/steps/build-step/__tests__/validate-task-round.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: repo.add on a Python repo registers it, stores the default commands with no prompt and reports buildDefaults applied
repo.add on a repo whose entry already holds commands keeps them and reports already-set
A failing write still registers the repo and the add succeeds
A repo whose commands came from the add defaults is gated by those commands as an ordinary repo setting
